historical_commentary.text: The fundamental referential integrity concepts described here remain fully valid in current 4D, though ORDA's relation attributes (introduced in 4D v17+) provide an additional, more modern way to define and navigate these relationships alongside the classic structure-level automatic relations this note discusses.
related_updates: ORDA (introduced in 4D v17+) provides an additional, object-based way to define and navigate relations, alongside the classic structure-level automatic relations described in this note
